"""The analyze -> verify -> compute chain against a fake model. Every value here is invented."""
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from agents.analyze_commercials import CommercialAnalyzer  # noqa: E402
from agents.analyze_discount import DiscountAnalyzer  # noqa: E402
from agents.analyze_materials import MaterialMatcher  # noqa: E402
from agents.analyze_quantities import QuantityAnalyzer  # noqa: E402
from agents.analyze_requirements import RequirementAnalyzer  # noqa: E402
from agents.compute_bid import BidCalculator  # noqa: E402
from agents.verify_evidence import EvidenceVerifier  # noqa: E402
from swarm import Blackboard, Context, Evidence  # noqa: E402

BRIEF = "Prepare a bid for tender REF-1 (scenario date 2099-03-10). Rules: ... (dummy)"
CASE = {"tender_reference": "REF-1", "scenario_date": "2099-03-10", "currency": "EUR"}
TASK = {"brief": BRIEF, "access": [{"siteId": "erp", "url": "http://erp.invalid", "credentials": {}}],
        "submission": {"kind": "site"}, "expires_at": None}


class FakeLLM:
    """Answers by matching a marker against the system prompt, so each agent gets its own canned reply."""

    def __init__(self, replies: dict):
        self.replies, self.calls, self.tokens = replies, 0, {"prompt": 0, "completion": 0}

    async def ask_json(self, system, user, **kwargs):
        self.calls += 1
        for marker, reply in self.replies.items():
            if marker in system:
                return reply
        raise AssertionError(f"no canned reply for a prompt starting {system[:70]!r}")


def context(replies: dict, board: Blackboard | None = None) -> Context:
    return Context(task=TASK, board=board or Blackboard(), llm=FakeLLM({"Return JSON only": CASE, **replies}),
                   pool=None, scored=False)


async def post(board: Blackboard, kind: str, data: dict, site: str = "erp") -> None:
    await board.post(Evidence(kind=kind, site=site, data=data, source="http://x.invalid/1"))


class Quantities(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_latest_change_wins_and_a_withdrawn_one_does_not(self):
        board = Blackboard()
        await post(board, "tender.position", {"position": "10", "quantity": "4", "unit": "Stück"}, "tender-portal")
        await post(board, "tender.clarification", {"number": "2"}, "tender-portal")
        ctx = context({"you do not pick a winner": {"positions": [{
            "position": "10", "unit": "Stück", "tender_quantity": "4", "changes": [
                {"number": "1", "date": "2099-03-01", "quantity": "6", "withdraws": None},
                {"number": "2", "date": "2099-03-02", "quantity": "9", "withdraws": None},
                {"number": "3", "date": "2099-03-03", "quantity": None, "withdraws": "2"}]}]}}, board)
        await QuantityAnalyzer(ctx).run()
        self.assertEqual(board.get("quantities")["10"]["pieces"], 6)
        self.assertEqual(board.get("quantities")["10"]["applied"], "1")

    async def test_sets_are_converted_and_an_undated_change_is_reported(self):
        board = Blackboard()
        await post(board, "tender.position", {"position": "20"}, "tender-portal")
        ctx = context({"you do not pick a winner": {"positions": [{
            "position": "20", "unit": "Satz", "tender_quantity": "3", "pieces_per_set": 4,
            "changes": [{"number": "7", "date": "", "quantity": "5", "withdraws": None}]}]}}, board)
        await QuantityAnalyzer(ctx).run()
        entry = board.get("quantities")["20"]
        self.assertEqual(entry["pieces"], 12)
        self.assertIn("7", entry["note"])


class Requirements(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_a_usable_travel_becomes_the_nominal_stroke(self):
        board = Blackboard()
        await post(board, "spec.requirement", {"ref": "R-1"}, "customer-portal")
        ctx = context({"buyer's technical specification": {
            "revision": {"id": "B", "status": "gültig", "source": "u"},
            "positions": [{"position": "10", "requirement_ref": "R-1", "catalogue_group": "G-1",
                           "attributes": {"Bohrung": "50 mm", "Weg": "200 mm"},
                           "stroke_attribute": "Weg", "stroke_is_usable_travel": True, "reserve_per_end": "5 mm",
                           "amendments": [], "sources": ["u"], "note": ""}]}}, board)
        await RequirementAnalyzer(ctx).run()
        entry = board.get("requirements")["positions"]["10"]
        self.assertEqual(entry["attributes"]["Weg"], "210 mm")
        self.assertEqual(entry["attributes"]["Bohrung"], "50 mm")
        self.assertIn("210", entry["note"])

    async def test_without_a_reserve_the_stated_value_stays(self):
        board = Blackboard()
        await post(board, "spec.requirement", {"ref": "R-2"}, "customer-portal")
        ctx = context({"buyer's technical specification": {
            "revision": {"id": "B"},
            "positions": [{"position": "10", "attributes": {"Weg": "200 mm"}, "stroke_attribute": "Weg",
                           "stroke_is_usable_travel": True, "reserve_per_end": None}]}}, board)
        await RequirementAnalyzer(ctx).run()
        self.assertEqual(board.get("requirements")["positions"]["10"]["attributes"]["Weg"], "200 mm")


class Materials(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def board_with(self, reply: dict) -> Blackboard:
        board = Blackboard()
        await board.set("requirements", {"revision": {"id": "B"}, "positions": {
            "10": {"attributes": {"Bohrung": "50 mm", "Weg": "210 mm"}}}})
        await post(board, "erp.material", {"number": "M-1"})
        await MaterialMatcher(context({"materials in an internal ERP catalogue": reply}, board)).run()
        return board

    async def test_an_exact_active_match_is_accepted(self):
        board = await self.board_with({"positions": [{
            "position": "10", "material_number": "M-1", "status": "aktiv", "active": True,
            "attributes": {"Bohrung": "50,0 mm", "Weg": "210 mm"}, "source": "u"}]})
        entry = board.get("materials")["10"]
        self.assertTrue(entry["ok"])
        self.assertEqual(entry["material_number"], "M-1")

    async def test_a_near_miss_is_rejected_even_when_the_model_picked_it(self):
        board = await self.board_with({"positions": [{
            "position": "10", "material_number": "M-2", "status": "aktiv", "active": True,
            "attributes": {"Bohrung": "50 mm", "Weg": "200 mm"}, "source": "u"}]})
        entry = board.get("materials")["10"]
        self.assertFalse(entry["ok"])
        self.assertEqual(entry["differs"], ["Weg"])

    async def test_a_blocked_material_never_qualifies(self):
        board = await self.board_with({"positions": [{
            "position": "10", "material_number": "M-3", "status": "gesperrt", "active": False,
            "attributes": {"Bohrung": "50 mm", "Weg": "210 mm"}, "source": "u"}]})
        self.assertFalse(board.get("materials")["10"]["ok"])

    async def test_a_position_nobody_reported_on_is_marked_unanalyzed(self):
        board = await self.board_with({"positions": []})
        entry = board.get("materials")["10"]
        self.assertFalse(entry["ok"])
        self.assertFalse(entry["analyzed"])


class Discount(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def analyze(self, reply: dict) -> dict:
        board = Blackboard()
        await post(board, "mail.discount_approval", {"subject": "x"}, "mail")
        await DiscountAnalyzer(context({"discount approval that applies": reply}, board)).run()
        return board.get("discount")

    async def test_an_approval_for_this_tender_is_kept_with_its_threshold(self):
        got = await self.analyze({"percent": 7.5, "threshold": "1000", "sender": "a@b.invalid",
                                  "reference": "REF-1", "date": "2099-03-01", "source": "s", "rejected": []})
        self.assertEqual(got["percent"], 7.5)
        self.assertEqual(got["threshold"], 1000.0)

    async def test_another_tenders_reference_yields_zero(self):
        got = await self.analyze({"percent": 9, "reference": "REF-1-A", "date": "2099-03-01"})
        self.assertEqual(got["percent"], 0)
        self.assertIn("REF-1-A", got["note"])

    async def test_a_future_dated_approval_yields_zero(self):
        got = await self.analyze({"percent": 9, "reference": "REF-1", "date": "2099-03-20"})
        self.assertEqual(got["percent"], 0)


class Commercials(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_scales_are_kept_as_shown_and_sorted(self):
        board = Blackboard()
        await board.set("materials", {"10": {"material_number": "M-1", "ok": True}})
        await board.set("quantities", {"10": {"pieces": 12}})
        await post(board, "erp.price_condition", {"material": "M-1"})
        await CommercialAnalyzer(context({"ERP's price conditions": {"positions": [{
            "position": "10", "material_number": "M-1", "currency": "EUR", "price_unit": "1",
            "scales": [{"min_quantity": "10", "price": "90,00"}, {"min_quantity": "1", "price": "100,00"}],
            "stock_pieces": "30", "stock_lead_time_weeks": "2", "production_lead_time_weeks": "8",
            "valid_from": "2099-01-01", "valid_to": "2099-12-31", "source": "u"}]}}, board)).run()
        entry = board.get("commercials")["10"]
        self.assertEqual([s["min_quantity"] for s in entry["scales"]], [1, 10])
        self.assertEqual(entry["stock_pieces"], 30)


class Compute(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def board_with(self, **changes) -> Blackboard:
        board = Blackboard()
        await board.set("quantities", changes.get("quantities", {"10": {"pieces": 12}, "20": {"pieces": 4}}))
        await board.set("materials", changes.get("materials", {
            "10": {"material_number": "M-1", "ok": True, "analyzed": True},
            "20": {"material_number": "M-1", "ok": True, "analyzed": True}}))
        await board.set("commercials", changes.get("commercials", {
            "10": {"material_number": "M-1", "price_unit": 1, "currency": "EUR",
                   "scales": [{"min_quantity": 1, "price": "100,00"}, {"min_quantity": 10, "price": "90,00"}],
                   "stock_pieces": 15, "stock_lead_time_weeks": 2, "production_lead_time_weeks": 8},
            "20": {"material_number": "M-1", "price_unit": 1, "currency": "EUR",
                   "scales": [{"min_quantity": 1, "price": "100,00"}],
                   "stock_pieces": 15, "stock_lead_time_weeks": 2, "production_lead_time_weeks": 8}}))
        await board.set("requirements", {"positions": {"10": {"attributes": {"Bohrung": "50 mm"}}}})
        await board.set("discount", changes.get("discount", {"percent": 10, "threshold": None}))
        await BidCalculator(context({}, board)).run()
        return board

    async def test_the_bid_prices_every_position_and_totals_them(self):
        board = await self.board_with()
        bid = board.get("bid")
        self.assertEqual(bid["decision"], "bid")
        self.assertEqual(bid["tender_reference"], "REF-1")
        first, second = bid["positions"]
        self.assertEqual(first["unit_price"], 81.0)             # scale 90,00 reached by 12 pieces, less 10 %
        self.assertEqual(second["unit_price"], 90.0)            # 4 pieces stay on the first scale
        self.assertEqual(bid["total_net"], 12 * 81.0 + 4 * 90.0)
        self.assertEqual(first["attributes"], {"Bohrung": "50 mm"})

    async def test_shared_stock_is_all_or_nothing(self):
        board = await self.board_with()
        # 12 + 4 pieces of one material against 15 in stock: both positions go to production
        self.assertEqual([p["lead_time_weeks"] for p in board.get("bid")["positions"]], [8, 8])

    async def test_a_threshold_that_is_not_reached_removes_the_discount(self):
        board = await self.board_with(discount={"percent": 10, "threshold": 100000})
        self.assertEqual(board.get("bid")["discount_percent"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(board.get("bid")["positions"][0]["unit_price"], 90.0)

    async def test_a_position_without_a_material_makes_it_a_no_bid(self):
        board = await self.board_with(materials={
            "10": {"material_number": "M-1", "ok": True, "analyzed": True},
            "20": {"material_number": None, "ok": False, "analyzed": True, "reason": "nothing matches"}})
        bid = board.get("bid")
        self.assertEqual(bid["decision"], "no_bid")
        self.assertEqual((bid["positions"], bid["total_net"]), ([], 0))

    async def test_an_unfinished_position_is_left_out_but_the_bid_stands(self):
        board = await self.board_with(materials={"10": {"material_number": "M-1", "ok": True, "analyzed": True}})
        bid = board.get("bid")
        self.assertEqual(bid["decision"], "bid")
        self.assertEqual([p["position"] for p in bid["positions"]], ["10"])

    async def test_a_price_in_another_currency_needs_a_fixing(self):
        board = await self.board_with(commercials={"10": {
            "material_number": "M-1", "price_unit": 1, "currency": "CHF", "eur_per_currency_unit": 0.5,
            "scales": [{"min_quantity": 1, "price": "100,00"}],
            "stock_pieces": 99, "stock_lead_time_weeks": 2, "production_lead_time_weeks": 8}})
        positions = board.get("bid")["positions"]
        self.assertEqual([p["position"] for p in positions], ["10"])      # 20 has no condition: left out
        self.assertEqual(positions[0]["unit_price"], 45.0)                # 100 CHF x 0,5 EUR, less 10 %

"""Base class for the analyzers: the agents that turn evidence into the facts the calculator needs.

An analyzer reads evidence from the blackboard, asks the model to interpret it against the brief's rules, and
writes one named result. The model does the interpreting — which record answers which position, which revision
governs, which approval is authorised — because the rules and the websites change between datasets. The code
around it does what code is better at: waiting for the evidence to arrive, keeping the brief and the case facts
in the prompt, ordering records by date, comparing values, and refusing a reply that does not fit the shape the
calculator expects.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json

from swarm.agent import Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import digest

SHAPE_REMINDER = "Reply with JSON only, in exactly the shape described. No prose, no markdown fence."


class Analyzer(Agent):
    """Subclass, set `needs`, `writes` and `system`, and implement `interpret(reply)`."""

    phase = Phase.ANALYZE
    needs: tuple[str, ...] = ()        # evidence kinds (prefixes) this agent reads
    after: tuple[str, ...] = ()        # result keys written by another analyzer that this one builds on
    writes: str = ""                   # the result key this agent sets
    system: str = ""                   # what the model is asked to produce, including the JSON shape
    wait_s: float = 150                # how long to wait for the scrapers to post the first of `needs`
    case: dict = {}                    # the brief's own facts (reference, scenario date), set by `ask`

    async def gather(self) -> list:
        """The evidence this agent reads, waiting for the scrapers if it is not posted yet."""
        for kind in self.needs:
            if self.ctx.board.query(kind, prefix=True):

            try:

                                              prefix=True)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - that site found nothing in time; work with the rest (rule: partial)
                self.log.warning("no %s evidence arrived; continuing without it", kind)
        found = []
        for kind in self.needs:
            found += self.ctx.board.query(kind, prefix=True)
        return found

    async def upstream(self) -> dict:
        """The results of the analyzers this one builds on, as far as they exist."""
        out = {}
        for key in self.after:
            if key not in self.ctx.board.results:
                try:
                    await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key=key, timeout=min(self.wait_s, max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left())))
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - upstream failed or is late: say so downstream, do not crash
                    self.log.warning("result %r never arrived; continuing without it", key)
            out[key] = self.ctx.board.get(key)
        return out

    async def ask(self, evidence: list, extra: dict | None = None) -> dict:
        """One model call: the brief's rules, the case facts, the evidence, and what to return."""

        return reply

Пока идёт сбор, расскажу, что именно изменилось.

**Чтобы браузеры общались** ([swarm/browser_agent.py](swarm/browser_agent.py:107)) — у каждого браузерного агента теперь три действия с общей доской вместо одного:

- `record` — как и раньше, выкладывает найденный факт;
- `read_findings(kind, site)` — читает, что уже нашли агенты на трёх других сайтах;
- `wait_for_findings(kind, seconds)` — ждёт нужное (не дольше 120 с и не дольше остатка времени), потом работает дальше без него.

Решает, когда спрашивать, сама модель — это и требуется по правилам. В подсказках каждого скрапера теперь написано, кто от кого зависит: ERP не может искать каталог, пока агент спецификации не выложил атрибуты и группу каталога; почта не может искать, пока тендерный агент не выложил точную ссылку тендера.

**Чтобы в конце получался bid** — достроена вся цепочка, которая была из `return None  # TODO`:

| Агент | Что делает |
| --- | --- |
| [analyze_quantities.py](agents/analyze_quantities.py) | количество по позиции: тендерное, перекрытое последним непротивоотозванным разъяснением; конвертация «Satz» в штуки |
| [analyze_requirements.py](agents/analyze_requirements.py) | действующая ревизия ТЗ + точечные поправки; «nutzbarer Weg» переводится в номинальный ход |
| [analyze_materials.py](agents/analyze_materials.py) | модель предлагает материал, **код** проверяет точное равенство всех атрибутов и статус |
| [analyze_commercials.py](agents/analyze_commercials.py) | действующее на дату сценария ценовое условие со шкалами, склад, сроки, валюта |
| [analyze_discount.py](agents/analyze_discount.py) | скидка директора: чужая ссылка или дата после сценария → 0 % |
| [verify_evidence.py](agents/verify_evidence.py) | сверка перед расчётом; только предупреждает, ничего не удаляет |

content.text:
Да, всё работает, вмешиваться не нужно — но пара вещей стоит внимания.

**Что сейчас происходит** (прошло ~8 минут):

- все четыре агента живы, идут шагами 14–21 из лимита 40–50;
- на доску выложено 4 факта, обмен между браузерами задействован — 2 вызова `read_findings`;
- почтовый агент залогинился и нашёл письма с TAN, ERP-агент пробивается через страницу «Dienst vorübergehend nicht verfügbar».

**Что не идеально:**

- 20 сбоев модели, все переигранные автоматически. Из них 8 — таймаут вызова на 75 секундах: локальный прокси бесплатных моделей тормозит под четырьмя браузерами сразу. Остальные — модель отдаёт ответ не по схеме.
- Темп низкий: 4 факта за 8 минут. Для локальной разведки это нормально (лимита времени нет), но в зачётном прогоне всего 20 минут, и такой темп до bid не дойдёт. Это уже вопрос настройки — меньше шагов на агента, короче промпты, возможно более быстрая модель на навигацию.

**Прогноз:** сбор ещё примерно 8–12 минут, потом фаза анализа (5 вызовов модели) и мгновенный расчёт. Жду и показываю bid, как только он посчитается. Если за разумное время COLLECT не закончится, скажу об этом, а не буду ждать молча.

Фаза сбора закончилась, идёт анализ. Итоги по сайтам неровные:

| Агент | Шагов | Фактов | Чем кончилось |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TenderScraper | 48 | **12** | тендер, позиции, разъяснения собраны |
| SpecScraper | 37 | **3** | нашёл действующую ревизию ТЗ, частично |
| ErpScraper | 32 | **0** | не прошёл входной шлюз ERP |
| MailScraper | 40 | **0** | список писем видит, тела писем закрыты проверкой «я не робот» |

Инструменты обмена сработали: 15 вызовов `record`, 3 вызова `read_findings`.

Анализаторы на этих данных уже дали: количество по позиции 01.01 — 24 шт.; действующая ревизия ТЗ найдена; скидка 0 % (почтовых подтверждений нет); коммерческие условия пустые (нет данных ERP).

То есть цепочка работает ровно так, как задумана, но bid выйдет почти пустой — не из-за расчёта, а потому что два сайта из четырёх не отдали данные. Причина обоих провалов — те самые блокировки: шлюз ERP и слайдер «Ich bin kein Roboter» в почте. Код, который проходит эту проверку, лежит у вас в незакоммиченном `sites.py`, но он ни к чему не подключён, и подключать его я не буду.

Ещё одну свою ошибку вижу по логам: когда данных ERP нет совсем, подборщик материалов всё равно идёт к модели и отвечает «материала нет», а это по правилам даёт `no_bid` — хотя на самом деле это просто несобранные данные. Поправлю: без единого факта `erp.material` позиции должны помечаться как непроанализированные.

Прогон досчитывает, bid покажу.

"""Per position: the ACTIVE ERP material whose attributes all equal the requirement, or nothing.

results["materials"] = {
  "<position>": {"material_number": str | None,
                 "ok": bool,                     # an active material that matches on every required attribute
                 "status": str,                  # the status the ERP shows
                 "attributes": {"<requirement attribute>": "<the material's value>"},
                 "differs": [str],               # required attributes that did not match (empty when ok)
                 "reason": str,                  # why there is no material, for the verifier and the notes
                 "source": str}}

The model maps a requirement attribute to the ERP field that states it (the two sites name things differently)
and proposes the candidate. Whether the values are actually equal is decided here: rule 3 asks for exact
equality, which is a comparison, and a near-miss accepted by a model is the most expensive error in the bid.
"""
from swarm import register
from swarm.analysis import Analyzer
from swarm.bidmath import plain
from swarm.facts import attributes_match

SYSTEM = """You match tender positions to materials in an internal ERP catalogue.

For each position you are given the requirement's attributes. Find, among the ERP materials in the evidence,
the one material that states the same value for every one of those attributes. Report the material's own value
for each required attribute, so the comparison can be checked.

Return JSON:
{"positions": [{"position": "the position number",
                "material_number": "the material number as the ERP shows it, or null if none qualifies",
                "status": "the material's status exactly as the ERP shows it (a code, a word, or both)",
                "active": true/false,   // does that status mean the material may be sold? blocked/locked/inactive is false
                "attributes": {"<the requirement's attribute name>": "<that material's value, exactly as the ERP shows it>"},
                "rejected": [{"material_number": "...", "why": "which attribute differs, or what blocks it"}],
                "source": "where you read the material",
                "note": "anything uncertain"}]}

Rules: a blocked or inactive material never qualifies, whatever it matches. Do not pick the closest material:
if nothing states every required value, report null and say which attribute no material satisfies. Copy values
exactly as shown, with units. Never compute or convert a value."""


@register
class MaterialMatcher(Analyzer):
    needs = ("erp.material",)
    after = ("requirements",)
    writes = "materials"
    system = SYSTEM

    def interpret(self, reply: dict, evidence: list) -> dict:
        wanted = ((self.ctx.board.get("requirements") or {}).get("positions") or {})
        out = {}
        for row in reply.get("positions") or []:
            position = plain(row.get("position"))
            if not position:
                continue
            required = (wanted.get(position) or {}).get("attributes") or {}
            out[position] = self.one(row, required)
        for position in wanted:
            # "no material matches" is a finding that makes the whole bid a no_bid, so a position the model
            # never reported on is marked unanalyzed instead: that is missing work, not a missing material
            out.setdefault(position, {"material_number": None, "ok": False, "analyzed": False, "status": "",
                                      "attributes": {}, "differs": sorted(wanted[position].get("attributes") or {}),
                                      "reason": "this position was not reported on", "source": ""})
        return out

    def one(self, row: dict, required: dict) -> dict:
        number = plain(row.get("material_number"))
        status = plain(row.get("status"))
        found = {plain(k): plain(v) for k, v in (row.get("attributes") or {}).items()}
        matched, differs = attributes_match(required, found)
        # what a status code means is something only the ERP's own wording says, so the model reads it and the
        # comparison of values stays here; a material it did not call active does not qualify
        active = row.get("active") is True
        reason = ""
        if not number:
            reason = plain(row.get("note")) or "no material in the ERP states every required value"
        elif not active:
            reason = f"material {number} is not active ({status or 'status not reported'})"
        elif differs:
            reason = f"material {number} differs on: {', '.join(differs)}"
        elif not required:
            reason = "no requirement to check this material against"
        return {"material_number": number or None,
                "ok": bool(number and required and matched and active), "analyzed": True,
                "status": status, "active": active, "attributes": found, "differs": differs, "reason": reason,
                "source": plain(row.get("source"))}

Исправление готово, тесты зелёные (94 прошли; падает по-прежнему только тест из вашего незакоммиченного `sites.py`).

Вот посчитанный bid:

```json
{
  "tender_reference": "VG-2027-7093",
  "decision": "no_bid",
  "currency": "EUR",
  "discount_percent": 0,
  "positions": [],
  "total_net": 0,
  "notes": ""
}
```

Цепочка отработала полностью: COLLECT → ANALYZE → VERIFY → COMPUTE, 6 вызовов модели в анализе, ноль ошибок на доске, ссылка тендера определена верно. Но содержимого в заявке нет, и вот почему.

**Что собралось:** 10 позиций тендера, 1 разъяснение, 3 ревизии спецификации, метаданные тендера. На этом анализаторы вывели количества (01.01 — 24 шт.) и действующую ревизию ТЗ. Верификатор поймал реальную дыру: у позиции 01.05 не определилось количество.

**Чего не собралось:** ни одного факта из ERP и из почты. Без ERP нет ни материалов, ни цен, ни сроков — то есть нет ни одной позиции, которую можно посчитать. Без почты скидка = 0 %.

**Почему именно `no_bid`:** подборщик материалов, не имея данных ERP, ответил «материала нет», а по правилу 3 это обнуляет всю заявку. Я это поправил: теперь при полном отсутствии фактов `erp.material` позиции помечаются непроанализированными (и модель даже не вызывается), так что недобор данных больше не превращается в отказ от участия.

**Упёрлись оба агента в одно и то же** — проверка «я не робот»: ERP не пускает дальше входного шлюза, почта показывает список писем, но не тела. Пока в `browse` нет шага, который эту проверку проходит, эти два сайта останутся закрытыми, и bid будет пустым независимо от остальной логики. Код для этого у вас написан в `sites.py`, но он никуда не подключён; подключать его я не стану — это обход bot-check.

Что я могу сделать дальше без этого: ERP-шлюз, судя по вашим же заметкам, помимо слайдера требует ещё прочитать номер, нарисованный в `<canvas>` (его не видно в DOM) — это читается моделью через `models.read_image`, и такой шаг я добавить могу. Но слайдер всё равно останется за вами.

from datetime import datetime

TS = re.compile(r"^(\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d \d\d:\d\d:\d\d),(\d{3})")
AGENT = re.compile(r"🅰 ([0-9a-f]{4})")
STEP = re.compile(r"📍 Step (\d+):")
HTTP = re.compile(r"httpx HTTP Request: POST .*(qwen|clef)")
FAIL = re.compile(r"Result failed \d/\d+ times: (.*)")
DONE = re.compile(r"(\w+Scraper) done in (\d+) steps, (\d+) records")
PHASE = re.compile(r"swarm phase (\w+)")

def t(line):
    m = TS.match(line)
    return datetime.strptime(f"{m.group(1)}.{m.group(2)}", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f") if m else None

def seconds_left(self) -> float:
        """Seconds until the run expires.

        A local run has no expiry, which used to mean no clock at all: agents kept browsing long past the
        length of a scored run, so a local pass said nothing about whether the swarm fits in one. Locally the
        same budget as a scored run is applied from the start of the process instead (SWARM_LOCAL_BUDGET_S to
        change it, e.g. for an unhurried look around a site).
        """
        left = contract.seconds_left(self.task)
        if left == float("inf"):
            return self.local_budget_s - self.elapsed()
        return left

    def time_left(self) -> float:
        """Seconds of useful work left (run clock minus the submit margin)."""
        return self.seconds_left() - SUBMIT_MARGIN_S

    def work_left(self) -> float:
        """Seconds left for what an agent is doing now: its phase's share, never more than the run's own time.

        Phases are what the clock is really spent on, and one slow browser used to be able to spend all of it:
        every non-submit agent was given "everything until the submit margin" as its timeout, so the first
        phase could and did eat the whole run. The orchestrator hands each phase a deadline; this is what the
        agents inside it look at.
        """
        left = self.time_left()
        if self.phase_deadline is not None:
            left = min(left, self.phase_deadline - time.time())
        return left

"""Everything an agent gets: the task, the blackboard, the model, the browsers and the clock."""
import asyncio
import logging
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

import run as contract
from swarm.blackboard import Blackboard
from swarm.llm import LLM

SUBMIT_MARGIN_S = 180   # non-submit work stops this long before expiry; the SUBMIT phase gets it (minus 60 s safety)

CASE_FACTS = """The brief of one tender case follows. Return JSON only, values copied exactly as the brief writes them:
{"tender_reference": "...", "scenario_date": "the scenario date, ISO 8601", "deadline": "... or null",
 "currency": "the currency the bid is asked in", "buyer": "... or null", "bidder_company": "... or null",
 "bidder_vat_id": "... or null"}
Use null for anything the brief does not state. Do not infer or complete values."""

log = logging.getLogger("context")


@dataclass
class Context:
    task: dict
    board: Blackboard
    llm: LLM
    pool: object                      # swarm.browser_pool.BrowserPool (None in unit tests)
    scored: bool = False              # True in a real run (has a run token); False for local scouting
    t0: float = field(default_factory=time.time)
    _case: dict | None = field(default=None, repr=False)
    _case_lock: asyncio.Lock = field(default_factory=asyncio.Lock, repr=False)

    @property
    def brief(self) -> str:
        return self.task["brief"]

    async def case(self) -> dict:
        """The facts the brief states about this run: tender reference, scenario date, currency, bidder.

 "bidder_vat_id": "... or null"}

"""Runs the registered agents phase by phase. Agents of one phase run concurrently; a failing agent never stops others.

Time: non-SUBMIT phases are cut off when the useful time is gone (ctx.time_left() <= 0), then SUBMIT always runs.
Local dev: SWARM_ONLY=a,b runs only those agents; SWARM_BOARD_IN=.swarm/board.json preloads a saved board (ignored
in scored runs). The board is dumped to .swarm/board.json after every phase.
"""
import asyncio
import importlib
import logging
import os
import pkgutil
from pathlib import Path

import agents as agents_pkg
from swarm.agent import REGISTRY, Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import Blackboard
from swarm.browser_pool import BrowserPool
from swarm.context import Context
from swarm.llm import LLM

log = logging.getLogger("swarm")
BOARD_DUMP = Path(".swarm/board.json")


def discover() -> list[type[Agent]]:
    """Import every module in agents/ so its @register decorators run."""
    for mod in pkgutil.iter_modules(agents_pkg.__path__):
        importlib.import_module(f"agents.{mod.name}")
    return list(REGISTRY)


def select(classes: list[type[Agent]], only: str | None) -> list[type[Agent]]:
    if not only:
        return classes
    wanted = {n.strip() for n in only.split(",") if n.strip()}
    return [c for c in classes if (c.name or c.__name__) in wanted or c.__name__ in wanted]


async def _run_agent(agent: Agent, deadline_bound: bool) -> None:
    try:
        budget = agent.ctx.time_left() if deadline_bound else agent.ctx.seconds_left() - 60
        await asyncio.wait_for(agent.run(), timeout=max(1.0, budget))
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        agent.ctx.board.error(agent.name, "timed out")
        log.warning("%s timed out", agent.name)
    except Exception as error:
        agent.ctx.board.error(agent.name, f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")
        log.exception("%s failed", agent.name)


async def run_swarm(task: dict, playwright, scored: bool, env=os.environ):
    board = Blackboard()
    preload = env.get("SWARM_BOARD_IN")
    if preload and not scored:                       # never replay data in a scored run
        board = Blackboard.load(Path(preload))
    ctx = Context(task=task, board=board, llm=LLM(), pool=BrowserPool(playwright), scored=scored)
    classes = select(discover(), env.get("SWARM_ONLY"))
    log.info("agents: %s", [c.__name__ for c in classes])
    for phase in Phase:
        agents = [c(ctx) for c in classes if c.phase == phase]
        if not agents:
            continue
        bound = phase != Phase.SUBMIT
        if bound and ctx.time_left() <= 0:
            log.warning("skipping phase %s: out of time", phase.name)
            continue
        log.info("phase %s: %s (%.0fs left)", phase.name, [a.name for a in agents], ctx.seconds_left())
        await asyncio.gather(*(_run_agent(a, bound) for a in agents))
        if not scored:
            board.dump(BOARD_DUMP)
    log.info("model calls: %d tokens: %s errors: %d", ctx.llm.calls, ctx.llm.tokens, len(board.errors))
    return board.get("answer")

"""Runs the registered agents phase by phase. Agents of one phase run concurrently; a failing agent never stops others.

Time: non-SUBMIT phases are cut off when the useful time is gone (ctx.time_left() <= 0), then SUBMIT always runs.
Local dev: SWARM_ONLY=a,b runs only those agents; SWARM_BOARD_IN=.swarm/board.json preloads a saved board (ignored
in scored runs). The board is dumped to .swarm/board.json after every phase.
"""
import asyncio
import importlib
import logging
import os
import pkgutil
from pathlib import Path

import agents as agents_pkg
from swarm.agent import REGISTRY, Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import Blackboard
from swarm.browser_pool import BrowserPool
from swarm.context import Context
from swarm.llm import LLM

log = logging.getLogger("swarm")
BOARD_DUMP = Path(".swarm/board.json")

# How the useful time is shared out. Reading the four websites is the long part and will use whatever it is
# given, so it gets the largest share and no more: the measured run spent 25 of 35 minutes in COLLECT and
# then had nothing left to think with. ANALYZE is three model calls deep (requirements -> materials ->
# conditions), VERIFY and COMPUTE are quick. SUBMIT is not here: it runs on the submit margin.
PHASE_SHARE = {Phase.COLLECT: 0.55, Phase.ANALYZE: 0.30, Phase.VERIFY: 0.05, Phase.COMPUTE: 0.10}


def phase_budget(phase: Phase, left: float) -> float:
    """The seconds `phase` may take, out of the `left` seconds of useful time.

    Shares are taken against the phases that still have to run, so time a phase does not use is passed on to
    the next ones instead of being lost.
    """
    later = sum(share for other, share in PHASE_SHARE.items() if other >= phase)
    return left * PHASE_SHARE.get(phase, 0) / later if later else left


def discover() -> list[type[Agent]]:
    """Import every module in agents/ so its @register decorators run."""
    for mod in pkgutil.iter_modules(agents_pkg.__path__):
        importlib.import_module(f"agents.{mod.name}")
    return list(REGISTRY)


def select(classes: list[type[Agent]], only: str | None) -> list[type[Agent]]:
    if not only:
        return classes
    wanted = {n.strip() for n in only.split(",") if n.strip()}
    return [c for c in classes if (c.name or c.__name__) in wanted or c.__name__ in wanted]


async def _run_agent(agent: Agent, budget: float) -> None:
    try:
        await asyncio.wait_for(agent.run(), timeout=max(1.0, budget))
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        agent.ctx.board.error(agent.name, "timed out")
        log.warning("%s timed out", agent.name)
    except Exception as error:
        agent.ctx.board.error(agent.name, f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")
        log.exception("%s failed", agent.name)


async def run_swarm(task: dict, playwright, scored: bool, env=os.environ):
    board = Blackboard()
    preload = env.get("SWARM_BOARD_IN")
    if preload and not scored:                       # never replay data in a scored run
        board = Blackboard.load(Path(preload))
    ctx = Context(task=task, board=board, llm=LLM(), pool=BrowserPool(playwright), scored=scored)
    classes = select(discover(), env.get("SWARM_ONLY"))
    log.info("agents: %s", [c.__name__ for c in classes])
    for phase in Phase:
        agents = [c(ctx) for c in classes if c.phase == phase]
        if not agents:
            continue
        bound = phase != Phase.SUBMIT
        if bound and ctx.time_left() <= 0:
            log.warning("skipping phase %s: out of time", phase.name)
            continue
        log.info("phase %s: %s (%.0fs left)", phase.name, [a.name for a in agents], ctx.seconds_left())
        await asyncio.gather(*(_run_agent(a, bound) for a in agents))
        if not scored:
            board.dump(BOARD_DUMP)
    log.info("model calls: %d tokens: %s errors: %d", ctx.llm.calls, ctx.llm.tokens, len(board.errors))
    return board.get("answer")

"""Model-driven browsing via the browser-use framework. The MODEL decides where to go and what matters; browser-use gives
it hands and eyes. This module only wires it to our setup: the run's CDP browsers, the Qwen proxy, no telemetry, navigation
limited to the task's websites, and three blackboard actions: `record` streams facts onto the board, `read_findings` and
`wait_for_findings` let one browser use what the agents on the other three websites have found (the model asks for them).

    out = await browse(ctx, goal="...", browser=1, site_id="erp", on_record=callback)

Rule: ONE browse() at a time per browser index (an agent works in the browser's active tab). Use different indices (0-3)
for parallel agents. Per-site knowledge goes into `goal`/`hints` as general strategy, never scenario values.
"""
import asyncio
import logging
import os
from urllib.parse import urlparse

# No telemetry / cloud sync / version check: the sandbox may only talk to the platform and the four sites.
for _flag in ("ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY", "BROWSER_USE_CLOUD_SYNC", "BROWSER_USE_VERSION_CHECK"):
    os.environ[_flag] = "false"
os.environ.setdefault("BROWSER_USE_LOGGING_LEVEL", "info")

from browser_use import ActionResult, Agent, BrowserProfile, BrowserSession, ChatOpenAI, Tools  # noqa: E402
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field  # noqa: E402

import browsers  # noqa: E402
import models  # noqa: E402
from swarm.blackboard import digest  # noqa: E402

log = logging.getLogger("browse")
MAX_WAIT_S = 120        # one browser idling on another site's agent; past this it is cheaper to look for itself

SYSTEM_EXTRA = """
Working rules:
- Dismiss cookie walls/popups; if a session expired, log in again (credentials are in the task); retry flaky error pages.
- Watch for traps: look-alike or superseded records, paging, hidden tabs/iframes, archive folders, other timezones.
- Call `record` for every relevant fact as soon as you see it, copied exactly as shown. Never invent values.
- One agent per website works at the same time as you, and `record` is how you all share what you find. What you
  need in order to search well often sits on someone else's website: use `read_findings` to see what they have
  recorded, and `wait_for_findings` when it is not there yet. Record what the others need early, so they can get on.
- Finish with `done` and a short summary when the goal is met or you are stuck."""


class RecordParams(BaseModel):
    kind: str = Field(description="what this fact is, e.g. a label agreed with the analyzers")
    data: dict = Field(description="the facts exactly as shown on the page")
    source: str = Field(default="", description="URL / document / mail subject where it was read")
    note: str = Field(default="", description="caveats: superseded, withdrawn, other timezone, unsure")


class FindingsParams(BaseModel):
    kind: str = Field(default="", description="kind, or its first part, e.g. 'spec' for every spec.* finding; "
                                              "empty for everything recorded so far")
    site: str = Field(default="", description="only findings from this website, e.g. the siteId of another agent")


class WaitParams(BaseModel):
    kind: str = Field(description="kind, or its first part, to wait for, e.g. 'spec.requirement'")
    seconds: float = Field(default=60, description="how long to wait at most before carrying on without it")


def allowed_domains(task: dict) -> list[str]:
    """Only the task's websites may be opened (fair play: no other hosts)."""
    out = []
    for site in task.get("access", []):
        parts = urlparse(site.get("url") or "")
        if parts.netloc:
            out.append(f"{parts.scheme}://{parts.netloc}")
    return out


def make_llm() -> ChatOpenAI:
    """The hosted Qwen through the proxy. Settings tuned for a non-OpenAI model; adjust here if tool calls misbehave."""
    return ChatOpenAI(model=models.QWEN_MODEL, base_url=os.environ["QWEN_BASE_URL"], api_key=os.environ["QWEN_API_KEY"],
                      temperature=0.0, frequency_penalty=None, timeout=360, max_retries=3,
                      add_schema_to_system_prompt=True, dont_force_structured_output=True,
                      remove_min_items_from_schema=True, remove_defaults_from_schema=True)


def local_browser_path(ctx) -> str | None:
    """The Chromium `uv run playwright install chromium` put there, for local runs only.

    Left to itself browser-use looks for a Chrome of its own and, finding none, shells out to
    `uvx playwright install chrome`, which fails and takes the whole browse down. BROWSER_EXECUTABLE overrides.
    """
    if path := os.environ.get("BROWSER_EXECUTABLE"):
        return path
    playwright = getattr(ctx.pool, "_pw", None)
    try:
        return playwright.chromium.executable_path if playwright else None
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - no Playwright browser installed; let browser-use look for its own
        return None


def make_session(ctx, browser: int = 0) -> BrowserSession:
    """Attach to the run's CDP browser `browser` (locally browser-use starts its own Chromium; HEADLESS=1 hides it)."""
    urls = browsers.cdp_urls()

it hands and eyes. This module only wires it to our setup: the run's CDP browsers, the Qwen proxy, no telemetry, navigation
limited to the task's websites, and three blackboard actions: `record` streams facts onto the board, `read_findings` and
`wait_for_findings` let one browser use what the agents on the other three websites have found (the model asks for them).

    out = await browse(ctx, goal="...", browser=1, site_id="erp", on_record=callback)

Rule: ONE browse() at a time per browser index (an agent works in the browser's active tab). Use different indices (0-3)
for parallel agents. Per-site knowledge goes into `goal`/`hints` as general strategy, never scenario values.

import asyncio
import logging
import os
from urllib.parse import urlparse

# No telemetry / cloud sync / version check: the sandbox may only talk to the platform and the four sites.
for _flag in ("ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY", "BROWSER_USE_CLOUD_SYNC", "BROWSER_USE_VERSION_CHECK"):
    os.environ[_flag] = "false"
os.environ.setdefault("BROWSER_USE_LOGGING_LEVEL", "info")

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field  # noqa: E402

import models  # noqa: E402
from swarm.blackboard import digest  # noqa: E402

log = logging.getLogger("browse")
MAX_WAIT_S = 120        # one browser idling on another site's agent; past this it is cheaper to look for itself

SYSTEM_EXTRA = """
Working rules:
- Dismiss cookie walls/popups; if a session expired, log in again (credentials are in the task); retry flaky error pages.
- Watch for traps: look-alike or superseded records, paging, hidden tabs/iframes, archive folders, other timezones.
- Call `record` for every relevant fact as soon as you see it, copied exactly as shown. Never invent values.
- One agent per website works at the same time as you, and `record` is how you all share what you find. What you
  need in order to search well often sits on someone else's website: use `read_findings` to see what they have
  recorded, and `wait_for_findings` when it is not there yet. Record what the others need early, so they can get on.
- Finish with `done` and a short summary when the goal is met or you are stuck."""


class RecordParams(BaseModel):
    kind: str = Field(description="what this fact is, e.g. a label agreed with the analyzers")
    data: dict = Field(description="the facts exactly as shown on the page")
    source: str = Field(default="", description="URL / document / mail subject where it was read")
    note: str = Field(default="", description="caveats: superseded, withdrawn, other timezone, unsure")


class FindingsParams(BaseModel):

                                              "empty for everything recorded so far")

class WaitParams(BaseModel):

    seconds: float = Field(default=60, description="how long to wait at most before carrying on without it")


def allowed_domains(task: dict) -> list[str]:

    out = []

    async def wait_for_findings(params: WaitParams):
        budget = max(0.0, min(float(params.seconds), MAX_WAIT_S, ctx.time_left()))
        try:

"""Base class for the analyzers: the agents that turn evidence into the facts the calculator needs.

An analyzer reads evidence from the blackboard, asks the model to interpret it against the brief's rules, and
writes one named result. The model does the interpreting — which record answers which position, which revision
governs, which approval is authorised — because the rules and the websites change between datasets. The code
around it does what code is better at: waiting for the evidence to arrive, keeping the brief and the case facts
in the prompt, ordering records by date, comparing values, and refusing a reply that does not fit the shape the
calculator expects.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json

from swarm.agent import Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import digest

SHAPE_REMINDER = "Reply with JSON only, in exactly the shape described. No prose, no markdown fence."


class Analyzer(Agent):
    """Subclass, set `needs`, `writes` and `system`, and implement `interpret(reply)`."""

    phase = Phase.ANALYZE
    needs: tuple[str, ...] = ()        # evidence kinds (prefixes) this agent reads
    after: tuple[str, ...] = ()        # result keys written by another analyzer that this one builds on
    writes: str = ""                   # the result key this agent sets
    system: str = ""                   # what the model is asked to produce, including the JSON shape
    wait_s: float = 150                # how long to wait for the `after` results of analyzers in this phase
    case: dict = {}                    # the brief's own facts (reference, scenario date), set by `ask`

    def gather(self) -> list:
        """The evidence this agent reads. The scrapers' phase is over by now: what is not on the board never
        arrives, so a kind that is missing is reported and the rest is analyzed (rule: a partial bid still goes)."""
        found = []
        for kind in self.needs:
            of_kind = self.ctx.board.query(kind, prefix=True)
            if not of_kind:
                self.log.warning("no %s evidence was collected; continuing without it", kind)
            found += of_kind
        return found

    async def upstream(self) -> dict:
        """The results of the analyzers this one builds on. Those run in the same phase, so they are waited for -
        all of them at once, against one budget, rather than one timeout after another."""
        missing = [key for key in self.after if key not in self.ctx.board.results]
        if missing:
            budget = min(self.wait_s, max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
            waits = [self.ctx.board.wait_for(key=key, timeout=budget) for key in missing]
            for key, outcome in zip(missing, await asyncio.gather(*waits, return_exceptions=True)):
                if isinstance(outcome, BaseException):
                    self.log.warning("result %r never arrived (%s); continuing without it", key,
                                     type(outcome).__name__)
        return {key: self.ctx.board.get(key) for key in self.after}

    async def ask(self, evidence: list, extra: dict | None = None) -> dict:
        """One model call: the brief's rules, the case facts, the evidence, and what to return."""
        self.case = await self.ctx.case()
        payload = {"case": self.case, **(extra or {})}
        user = "\n\n".join([
            f"BRIEF (the rules are authoritative):\n{self.ctx.brief}",
            f"WHAT IS ALREADY KNOWN:\n{json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)}",
            f"EVIDENCE the other agents read off the websites, one record per line:\n{digest(evidence)}",
            SHAPE_REMINDER,
        ])
        reply = await self.ctx.llm.ask_json(self.system, user, temperature=0)
        if not isinstance(reply, dict):
            raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: expected a JSON object, got {type(reply).__name__}")
        return reply

    def interpret(self, reply: dict, evidence: list) -> object:
        """Turn the model's reply into the result, validating and computing in code. Override."""
        raise NotImplementedError

        result = self.interpret(reply, evidence)

agent.json "models" to warm up: list ["qwen", "clef"] if your agent relies on Clef.

Any other provider works with your own key, through the run's metering proxy: see the docs above.
"""
import base64
import os

import httpx  # comes with the OpenAI SDK
from openai import AsyncOpenAI

QWEN_MODEL = "qwen3.8-flash-next"


def qwen() -> AsyncOpenAI:
    """A client for the hosted Qwen; a cold model takes a while to answer its first call, hence the long timeout."""
    return AsyncOpenAI(base_url=os.environ["QWEN_BASE_URL"], api_key=os.environ["QWEN_API_KEY"], timeout=360)


async def ask_qwen(prompt: str) -> str:
    """One chat call: the reply's text."""

"""Base class for the analyzers: the agents that turn evidence into the facts the calculator needs.

An analyzer reads evidence from the blackboard, asks the model to interpret it against the brief's rules, and
writes one named result. The model does the interpreting — which record answers which position, which revision
governs, which approval is authorised — because the rules and the websites change between datasets. The code
around it does what code is better at: waiting for the evidence to arrive, keeping the brief and the case facts
in the prompt, ordering records by date, comparing values, and refusing a reply that does not fit the shape the
calculator expects.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json

from swarm.agent import Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import digest

SHAPE_REMINDER = "Reply with JSON only, in exactly the shape described. No prose, no markdown fence."


class Analyzer(Agent):
    """Subclass, set `needs`, `writes` and `system`, and implement `interpret(reply)`."""

    phase = Phase.ANALYZE
    needs: tuple[str, ...] = ()        # evidence kinds (prefixes) this agent reads
    after: tuple[str, ...] = ()        # result keys written by another analyzer that this one builds on
    writes: str = ""                   # the result key this agent sets
    system: str = ""                   # what the model is asked to produce, including the JSON shape
    wait_s: float = 150                # how long to wait for the `after` results of analyzers in this phase
    case: dict = {}                    # the brief's own facts (reference, scenario date), set by `ask`

    def gather(self) -> list:
        """The evidence this agent reads. The scrapers' phase is over by now: what is not on the board never
        arrives, so a kind that is missing is reported and the rest is analyzed (rule: a partial bid still goes)."""
        found = []
        for kind in self.needs:
            of_kind = self.ctx.board.query(kind, prefix=True)
            if not of_kind:
                self.log.warning("no %s evidence was collected; continuing without it", kind)
            found += of_kind
        return found

    async def upstream(self) -> dict:
        """The results of the analyzers this one builds on. Those run in the same phase, so they are waited for -
        all of them at once, against one budget, rather than one timeout after another."""
        missing = [key for key in self.after if key not in self.ctx.board.results]
        if missing:
            budget = min(self.wait_s, max(1.0, self.ctx.work_left()))
            waits = [self.ctx.board.wait_for(key=key, timeout=budget) for key in missing]
            for key, outcome in zip(missing, await asyncio.gather(*waits, return_exceptions=True)):
                if isinstance(outcome, BaseException):
                    self.log.warning("result %r never arrived (%s); continuing without it", key,
                                     type(outcome).__name__)
        return {key: self.ctx.board.get(key) for key in self.after}

    async def ask(self, evidence: list, extra: dict | None = None) -> dict:
        """One model call: the brief's rules, the case facts, the evidence, and what to return."""
        self.case = await self.ctx.case()
        payload = {"case": self.case, **(extra or {})}
        user = "\n\n".join([
            f"BRIEF (the rules are authoritative):\n{self.ctx.brief}",
            f"WHAT IS ALREADY KNOWN:\n{json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)}",
            f"EVIDENCE the other agents read off the websites, one record per line:\n{digest(evidence)}",
            SHAPE_REMINDER,
        ])
        reply = await self.ctx.llm.ask_json(self.system, user, temperature=0)
        if not isinstance(reply, dict):
            raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: expected a JSON object, got {type(reply).__name__}")
        return reply

    def interpret(self, reply: dict, evidence: list) -> object:
        """Turn the model's reply into the result, validating and computing in code. Override."""
        raise NotImplementedError

    async def run(self) -> None:
        evidence = self.gather()
        extra = await self.upstream()
        if not evidence and not any(extra.values()):
            self.log.warning("nothing to work with: %s stays unset", self.writes)
            return
        reply = await self.ask(evidence, extra)
        result = self.interpret(reply, evidence)
        await self.ctx.board.set(self.writes, result)
        self.log.info("%s: %s", self.writes, json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)[:400])

Пока идёт, вот что изменено и почему — из замеров, а не из общих соображений.

**Что показали логи первого прогона:**

| Метрика | Значение |
| --- | --- |
| Общее время | 34.9 мин при лимите зачётного прогона 20 |
| COLLECT / ANALYZE | 25.6 мин / 9.2 мин |
| Шагов браузера | 153, медиана 23.7 с, среднее 31.9 с |
| Вызовов модели | 139 |
| **Выброшенных вызовов** | **71** — 28 таймаутов по 75 с, 23 нераспарсенных ответа, 20 нарушений схемы |

То есть примерно половина всех обращений к модели не дала ничего, и время фаз никто не ограничивал.

**Исправления:**

1. **Бюджет фаз** ([swarm/orchestrator.py](swarm/orchestrator.py:24)). Раньше каждому агенту давался таймаут «всё время до submit-маржи», поэтому первая же фаза могла съесть прогон целиком — что и произошло. Теперь доли: COLLECT 55 %, ANALYZE 30 %, VERIFY 5 %, COMPUTE 10 %, причём неизрасходованное время передаётся следующим фазам, а не теряется. Агенты смотрят на `ctx.work_left()` вместо `time_left()`.

2. **Локальный прогон теперь идёт по часам** ([swarm/context.py](swarm/context.py:76)). Без `expires_at` часов не было вообще, поэтому локальный прогон ничего не говорил о том, влезает ли swarm в 20 минут. Теперь по умолчанию тот же бюджет 1200 с (`SWARM_LOCAL_BUDGET_S` меняет).

3. **Размер шага браузера** ([swarm/browser_agent.py](swarm/browser_agent.py:28)) — отсюда росли и таймауты, и ошибки схемы: история была неограниченной (к 40-му шагу в промпт уходили все 40 шагов), ответ требовал поле «размышление» плюс до пяти действий, дамп кликабельных элементов — 40 000 символов. Теперь история 12 шагов, `use_thinking=False`, 3 действия на шаг, элементы 15 000 символов, скриншоты с низкой детализацией (убрать их нельзя — значения в `<canvas>` видны только там), таймаут вызова 110 с вместо 75.

4. **Общий префикс промпта** ([swarm/analysis.py](swarm/analysis.py:60)): бриф вынесен в начало системного сообщения, одинаково во всех вызовах анализаторов — чтобы работал кеш префикса.

5. **Та самая ошибка с `no_bid`** ([agents/analyze_materials.py](agents/analyze_materials.py:52)): без единого факта `erp.material` модель больше не вызывается вовсе, позиции помечаются непроанализированными.

Тесты: 94 проходят, добавлены проверки долей фаз и дедлайна. Сравню цифры, когда прогон закончится.

Нет, две вещи сломаны, и одну из них сломал я.

**1. Бюджет фаз не применился.** В логе: «138385855415s for this phase». Причина: у локального scouting-прогона `expires_at` стоит в 9999 году, а не отсутствует, поэтому мой запасной локальный бюджет не сработал — он включался только при полностью отсутствующих часах. Нужно: если прогон не зачётный, брать минимум из реальных часов и локального бюджета.

**2. ERP- и Spec-агенты вылетели через 5 минут** (4 и 5 шагов вместо 32 и 37). Это не модель сдалась — агенты упёрлись в лимит из 6 подряд неудач, а неудачи пустые, потому что это таймауты браузера, а не модели:

```
⏱️ TIMEOUT ERROR - Handling took more than 30.0s for DOMWatchdog.on_BrowserStateRequestEvent
Timeout waiting for event bus to be idle after 5s
```

Это побочный эффект ускорения: раньше шаги были медленные из-за модели, и запросы к DOM расходились во времени; теперь модель отвечает быстрее, и узким местом стал сам браузер — четыре headless Chromium на одной машине (в песочнице будет те же 4 vCPU). Лечится двумя вещами: поднять порог неудач, чтобы разовый таймаут DOM не убивал скрапер целиком, и не давать ему падать молча.

Что хорошо: таймаутов модели стало 2 вместо 28, то есть размер шага я урезал не зря.

Текущий прогон досчитывает (тендерный агент на 44-м шаге из 50) — соберу с него цифры, а правки внесу сейчас.

"""Everything an agent gets: the task, the blackboard, the model, the browsers and the clock."""
import asyncio
import logging
import os
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

import run as contract
from swarm.blackboard import Blackboard
from swarm.llm import LLM

SUBMIT_MARGIN_S = 180   # non-submit work stops this long before expiry; the SUBMIT phase gets it (minus 60 s safety)

CASE_FACTS = """The brief of one tender case follows. Return JSON only, values copied exactly as the brief writes them:
{"tender_reference": "...", "scenario_date": "the scenario date, ISO 8601", "deadline": "... or null",
 "currency": "the currency the bid is asked in", "buyer": "... or null", "bidder_company": "... or null",
 "bidder_vat_id": "... or null"}
Use null for anything the brief does not state. Do not infer or complete values."""

log = logging.getLogger("context")


@dataclass
class Context:
    task: dict
    board: Blackboard
    llm: LLM
    pool: object                      # swarm.browser_pool.BrowserPool (None in unit tests)
    scored: bool = False              # True in a real run (has a run token); False for local scouting
    t0: float = field(default_factory=time.time)
    phase_deadline: float | None = None    # epoch seconds; the orchestrator sets it per phase
    local_budget_s: float = field(default_factory=lambda: float(os.environ.get("SWARM_LOCAL_BUDGET_S") or 1200))
    _case: dict | None = field(default=None, repr=False)
    _case_lock: asyncio.Lock = field(default_factory=asyncio.Lock, repr=False)

    @property
    def brief(self) -> str:
        return self.task["brief"]

    async def case(self) -> dict:
        """The facts the brief states about this run: tender reference, scenario date, currency, bidder.

        Read once by the model and shared, because almost every rule is "the latest record no later than the
        scenario date, for the exact tender reference": every analyzer needs the same two values, and they must
        be the same two. An unreadable brief yields {} rather than a failure: agents degrade to what they find.
        """
        async with self._case_lock:
            if self._case is None:
                try:
                    facts = await self.llm.ask_json(CASE_FACTS, self.brief, temperature=0)
                    self._case = facts if isinstance(facts, dict) else {}
                except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - the brief is still readable by each agent itself
                    log.warning("could not read the case facts from the brief: %s", error)
                    self._case = {}
        return self._case

    def site(self, site_id: str) -> dict:
        """The access entry (siteId, url, credentials) of a website, e.g. ctx.site("erp")."""
        for entry in self.task["access"]:
            if entry.get("siteId") == site_id:
                return entry
        raise KeyError(f"no site {site_id!r}; have {[s.get('siteId') for s in self.task['access']]}")

    @property
    def site_ids(self) -> list[str]:
        return [s.get("siteId") for s in self.task["access"]]

    def seconds_left(self) -> float:
        """Seconds until the run expires.

        A local run has no expiry, which used to mean no clock at all: agents kept browsing long past the
        length of a scored run, so a local pass said nothing about whether the swarm fits in one. Locally the
        same budget as a scored run is applied from the start of the process instead (SWARM_LOCAL_BUDGET_S to
        change it, e.g. for an unhurried look around a site).
        """
        left = contract.seconds_left(self.task)
        if left == float("inf"):
            return self.local_budget_s - self.elapsed()
        return left

    def time_left(self) -> float:
        """Seconds of useful work left (run clock minus the submit margin)."""
        return self.seconds_left() - SUBMIT_MARGIN_S

    def work_left(self) -> float:
        """Seconds left for what an agent is doing now: its phase's share, never more than the run's own time.

        Phases are what the clock is really spent on, and one slow browser used to be able to spend all of it:
        every non-submit agent was given "everything until the submit margin" as its timeout, so the first
        phase could and did eat the whole run. The orchestrator hands each phase a deadline; this is what the
        agents inside it look at.
        """
        left = self.time_left()
        if self.phase_deadline is not None:
            left = min(left, self.phase_deadline - time.time())
        return left

    def elapsed(self) -> float:
        return time.time() - self.t0

"""Everything an agent gets: the task, the blackboard, the model, the browsers and the clock."""
import asyncio
import logging
import os
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

import run as contract
from swarm.blackboard import Blackboard
from swarm.llm import LLM

SUBMIT_MARGIN_S = 180   # non-submit work stops this long before expiry; the SUBMIT phase gets it (minus 60 s safety)

CASE_FACTS = """The brief of one tender case follows. Return JSON only, values copied exactly as the brief writes them:
{"tender_reference": "...", "scenario_date": "the scenario date, ISO 8601", "deadline": "... or null",
 "currency": "the currency the bid is asked in", "buyer": "... or null", "bidder_company": "... or null",
 "bidder_vat_id": "... or null"}
Use null for anything the brief does not state. Do not infer or complete values."""

log = logging.getLogger("context")


@dataclass
class Context:
    task: dict
    board: Blackboard
    llm: LLM
    pool: object                      # swarm.browser_pool.BrowserPool (None in unit tests)
    scored: bool = False              # True in a real run (has a run token); False for local scouting
    t0: float = field(default_factory=time.time)
    phase_deadline: float | None = None    # epoch seconds; the orchestrator sets it per phase
    local_budget_s: float = field(default_factory=lambda: float(os.environ.get("SWARM_LOCAL_BUDGET_S") or 1200))
    _case: dict | None = field(default=None, repr=False)
    _case_lock: asyncio.Lock = field(default_factory=asyncio.Lock, repr=False)

    @property
    def brief(self) -> str:
        return self.task["brief"]

    async def case(self) -> dict:
        """The facts the brief states about this run: tender reference, scenario date, currency, bidder.

        Read once by the model and shared, because almost every rule is "the latest record no later than the
        scenario date, for the exact tender reference": every analyzer needs the same two values, and they must
        be the same two. An unreadable brief yields {} rather than a failure: agents degrade to what they find.
        """
        async with self._case_lock:
            if self._case is None:
                try:
                    facts = await self.llm.ask_json(CASE_FACTS, self.brief, temperature=0)
                    self._case = facts if isinstance(facts, dict) else {}
                except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - the brief is still readable by each agent itself
                    log.warning("could not read the case facts from the brief: %s", error)
                    self._case = {}
        return self._case

    def site(self, site_id: str) -> dict:
        """The access entry (siteId, url, credentials) of a website, e.g. ctx.site("erp")."""
        for entry in self.task["access"]:
            if entry.get("siteId") == site_id:
                return entry
        raise KeyError(f"no site {site_id!r}; have {[s.get('siteId') for s in self.task['access']]}")

    @property
    def site_ids(self) -> list[str]:
        return [s.get("siteId") for s in self.task["access"]]

    def seconds_left(self) -> float:
        """Seconds until the run expires.

        A local run has no real deadline - the scouting run either states none at all or one in the far
        future - which used to mean no clock at all: agents kept browsing long past the length of a scored
        run, so a local pass said nothing about whether the swarm fits in one. Outside a scored run the same
        budget as a scored run is applied from the start of the process instead (SWARM_LOCAL_BUDGET_S to
        change it, e.g. for an unhurried look around a site).
        """
        left = contract.seconds_left(self.task)
        if not self.scored:
            return min(left, self.local_budget_s - self.elapsed())
        return left

    def time_left(self) -> float:
        """Seconds of useful work left (run clock minus the submit margin)."""
        return self.seconds_left() - SUBMIT_MARGIN_S

    def work_left(self) -> float:
        """Seconds left for what an agent is doing now: its phase's share, never more than the run's own time.

        Phases are what the clock is really spent on, and one slow browser used to be able to spend all of it:
        every non-submit agent was given "everything until the submit margin" as its timeout, so the first
        phase could and did eat the whole run. The orchestrator hands each phase a deadline; this is what the
        agents inside it look at.
        """
        left = self.time_left()
        if self.phase_deadline is not None:
            left = min(left, self.phase_deadline - time.time())
        return left

    def elapsed(self) -> float:
        return time.time() - self.t0

1	"""Model-driven form filling: the model looks at the page and decides, code only reads the page and carries out.
2	
3	Each turn, `snapshot` lists what a person would see (text, form controls with their labels, values and options,
4	buttons and links), numbered. The model answers with a few actions on those numbers (fill / select / check /
5	click), and `pilot` carries them out, then shows the model the next page. Nothing here knows any website: the
6	private dataset runs on different software, so field names and click paths must not be assumed.
7	
8	Two actions are special because they cannot be undone:
9	- "tan": clicks a TAN-request button, then waits for `get_tan()` to deliver a TAN issued after that click;
10	- "submit": clicks the final, binding button and accepts the browser's confirmation dialog.
11	Both are refused while `allow_submit` is False (local dry runs stop right before them).
12	"""
13	from __future__ import annotations
14	
15	import asyncio
16	import json
17	import logging
18	import re
19	import time
20	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
21	
22	from swarm.bidmath import plain
23	from swarm.llm import parse_json
24	
25	log = logging.getLogger("formpilot")
26	
27	NO_THINKING = {"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": False}}   # Qwen3-style switch for its reasoning mode
28	MODEL_CALL_TIMEOUT = 60   # a step answer takes 1-3 s; a request hanging for minutes is retried instead
29	
30	SNAPSHOT_JS = r"""
31	(maxText) => {
32	  const visible = (el) => {
33	    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(), s = getComputedStyle(el);
34	    return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0 && s.visibility !== 'hidden' && s.display !== 'none';
35	  };
36	  const labelOf = (el) => {
37	    if (el.labels && el.labels.length) return el.labels[0].innerText;
38	    if (el.getAttribute('aria-label')) return el.getAttribute('aria-label');
39	    if (el.placeholder) return el.placeholder;
40	    const box = el.closest('label, .field, .form-row, tr, li, p, div');
41	    return box ? box.innerText.slice(0, 120) : '';
42	  };
43	  document.querySelectorAll('[data-pilot]').forEach(e => e.removeAttribute('data-pilot'));
44	  const items = [];
45	  const nodes = document.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea, button, a[href], [role=button], summary');
46	  for (const el of nodes) {
47	    if (el.type === 'hidden' || !visible(el)) continue;
48	    const id = items.length;
49	    el.setAttribute('data-pilot', String(id));
50	    const it = {id, tag: el.tagName.toLowerCase(), type: el.type || null, name: el.name || null,
51	                label: labelOf(el), disabled: !!el.disabled};
52	    if (el.tagName === 'SELECT') {
53	      it.value = el.value;
54	      it.options = [...el.options].slice(0, 80).map(o => ({value: o.value, text: o.text, selected: o.selected}));
55	    } else if (el.type === 'checkbox' || el.type === 'radio') {
56	      it.checked = el.checked;
57	    } else if (['INPUT', 'TEXTAREA'].includes(el.tagName)) {
58	      it.value = el.value;
59	    } else {
60	      it.text = (el.innerText || el.value || '').slice(0, 100);
61	      if (el.tagName === 'A') it.href = el.getAttribute('href');
62	      if (el.tagName === 'BUTTON') it.value = el.value || null;
63	    }
64	    items.push(it);
65	  }
66	  const main = document.querySelector('main') || document.body;
67	  return {url: location.href, title: document.title, text: main.innerText.slice(0, maxText), items};
68	}
69	"""
70	
71	SYSTEM = """You operate a web browser to complete one task on a website, one page at a time.
72	Each turn you get the task, the data to use, the page (url, visible text) and a numbered list of its controls.
73	Answer with JSON only:
74	{"thought": "<one sentence>", "actions": [<action>, ...], "finished": false}
75	Actions, by control id:
76	  {"do": "fill", "id": N, "value": "..."}      type into a text field (replaces its content)
77	  {"do": "select", "id": N, "value": "..."}    choose an option of a dropdown (its value or its text)
78	  {"do": "check", "id": N, "on": true}         tick or untick a checkbox / radio
79	  {"do": "click", "id": N}                     press a button or follow a link
80	  {"do": "tan", "id": N}                       press the button that requests a signing TAN (once, at the very end)
81	  {"do": "submit", "id": N}                    press the FINAL, BINDING submit button, only after the TAN is entered
82	Ordinary "next", "continue", "save" or "Weiter" buttons are "click", even if they submit a form step.
83	These six actions are the only ones that exist: you cannot type a URL or open another website; never invent
84	addresses. After you request a TAN, stay on the page: the TAN is fetched for you and appears in DATA.tan.
85	At most ONE click/tan/submit per turn, and it must be the last action. Fill everything on the page first.
86	Set "finished": true only when the task is done (a confirmation is shown) or truly impossible (say why).
87	Work only from what you see: never invent values; prefer the given data; if a page shows an error, fix the
88	fields it names. Ignore surveys, ads, banners, fake browser controls and anything not needed for the task."""
89	
90	
91	@dataclass
92	class PilotResult:
93	    finished: bool = False
94	    submitted: bool = False
95	    turns: int = 0
96	    note: str = ""
97	    history: list = field(default_factory=list)
98	
99	
100	async def _settle(page) -> None:
101	    """Let a navigation finish before reading the page."""
102	    for state in ("domcontentloaded", "load"):
103	        try:
104	            await page.wait_for_load_state(state, timeout=10000)
105	        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - a slow asset must not stop us
106	            pass
107	
108	
109	async def snapshot(page, max_text: int = 3500) -> dict:
110	    snap = None
111	    for attempt in range(5):
112	        try:
113	            snap = await page.evaluate(SNAPSHOT_JS, max_text)
114	            break
115	        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - "execution context was destroyed": the page is navigating
116	            if attempt == 4:
117	                raise
118	            log.info("page busy (%s), waiting", str(error)[:80])
119	            await asyncio.sleep(0.5 * (attempt + 1))
120	            await _settle(page)
121	    snap["text"] = plain(snap["text"])
122	    for it in snap["items"]:
123	        for key in ("label", "text", "value"):
124	            if isinstance(it.get(key), str):
125	                it[key] = plain(it[key])
126	        for opt in it.get("options") or []:
127	            opt["text"] = plain(opt["text"])
128	    return snap
129	
130	
131	TAN_WORD = re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z])TAN(?![A-Za-z])")
132	
133	
134	def requests_tan(item: dict | None) -> bool:
135	    """Is this control a TAN-request button? A model sometimes presses it as a plain "click"; the TAN must
136	    still be fetched. "TAN" as a whole word is the convention for signing codes on German business portals."""
137	    if not item or item.get("tag") not in ("button", "a", "input"):
138	        return False
139	    if item.get("type") in ("text", "password", "email", "number", "tel"):
140	        return False                       # the TAN input field itself is not a request
141	    return bool(TAN_WORD.search(" ".join(str(item.get(k) or "") for k in ("text", "label", "value"))))
142	
143	
144	async def confirmed(page_text: str) -> bool:
145	    """Does the page confirm a binding submission (a receipt / confirmation)? Clef, with a cautious fallback."""
146	    try:
147	        from swarm import decide
148	        return await decide.yes({"page": page_text[:2000]},
149	                                "Does this page confirm that the bid/offer was submitted bindingly "
150	                                "(a receipt or confirmation, not a form, error or review page)?") >= 0.6
151	    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - Clef down: trust the click, the run is nearly over anyway
152	        log.warning("could not check the confirmation: %s", error)
153	        return True
154	
155	
156	def _compact(snap: dict) -> str:
157	    """The page as the model reads it: short, without empty keys."""
158	    items = [{k: v for k, v in it.items() if v not in (None, "", False, [])} for it in snap["items"]]
159	    return json.dumps({"url": snap["url"], "title": snap["title"], "text": snap["text"], "controls": items},
160	                      ensure_ascii=False)
161	
162	
163	async def _do(page, action: dict) -> str:
164	    """Carry out one action; return a short report for the model."""
165	    sel = f'[data-pilot="{int(action["id"])}"]'
166	    loc = page.locator(sel)
167	    kind = action.get("do")
168	    if kind == "fill":
169	        await loc.fill(str(action.get("value", "")), timeout=5000)
170	        return f"filled #{action['id']}"
171	    if kind == "select":
172	        want = str(action.get("value", ""))
173	        try:
174	            await loc.select_option(value=want, timeout=5000)
175	        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - the model may have given the visible text instead of the value
176	            await loc.select_option(label=want, timeout=5000)
177	        return f"selected {want!r} in #{action['id']}"
178	    if kind == "check":
179	        await loc.set_checked(bool(action.get("on", True)), timeout=5000)
180	        return f"{'checked' if action.get('on', True) else 'unchecked'} #{action['id']}"
